title: Weekly mileage cap 10% -> 20% (backstop to the spike cap); duplicate settings removed
what: athlete_context.json thresholds.weekly_run_increase_pct 10 -> 20: now a looser backstop; the single-run spike cap (decision 105) is the main ramp guard. Removed running.max_weekly_increase_pct and gear.shoe_alert_miles, unused duplicates of thresholds.weekly_run_increase_pct and thresholds.shoe_alert_miles.
why: Audit 2026-11-22 (athlete approved all changes): the 10%-per-week rule didn't reduce injuries in an RCT (Buist 2008), and week-to-week change wasn't linked to injury in the Frandsen 2025 cohort (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12421110), while single-run spikes were. 20% is a practitioner backstop, not an evidence-based number.
